flagTable.emptyNoFlags: No flags yet. Add one or import a JSON file.
flagTable.resetDialogBody: This removes every flag you have set and restores the client defaults. You can’t undo this.

flagsPresets.lowMeshQualityDescription: Switch to lower-detail CSG meshes sooner, at every distance.
flagsPresets.pauseVoxelizerDescription: Stop terrain/CSG voxelization while it's running.
flagsPresets.preferredGraphicsApiDescription: Force a specific rendering backend instead of Roblox's own choice.
flagsPresets.textureQualityOverrideDescription: Force a texture quality level instead of Roblox's automatic setting.
flagsPresets.graySkyDescription: Replace the sky with flat gray, for debugging or lower-end GPUs.
flagsPresets.disableDpiScalingDescription: Render at 1:1 pixel scale, ignoring Windows display scaling.
flagsPresets.renderQualityLevelOverrideDescription: Force render manager (FRM) quality level, 0 for automatic.
flagsPresets.maxGrassDistanceDescription: Studs from the camera grass keeps rendering out to.
flagsPresets.minGrassDistanceDescription: Studs from the camera grass always renders within.
flagsPresets.grassMotionFactorDescription: Scales down how much grass sways; higher is stiller.
flagsPresets.handleAltEnterDescription: Let Roblox itself handle the Alt+Enter fullscreen toggle.

installations.parallelDownloadsDescription: How many packages to download at once.
installations.forceReinstallRobloxDescription: Redownload the client fresh next time it launches.
installations.disableRobloxUpgradesDescription: Keep the currently installed client version.
installations.vngDistributionDescription: DO NOT ENABLE THIS UNLESS YOUR ACCOUNT IS VNG. YOU WILL LOOSE YOUR ACCOUNT IF YOUR ROBLOX ACCOUNT IS NOT VNG.
installations.vngWarning1: This is roblox VNG, a Vietnamese distribution of Roblox. Its was meant for Vietnamese users, If you logged your account in Roblox VNG. You will loose your account forever.
installations.vngWarning2: Are you sure your account is VNG? You can check by logging in your account and press buy robux, if you got redirect to an VNG payment website. Thats mean your account is VNG.
installations.vngWarning3: Are you really sure? You can't undo if your account is in VNG.
